items.summary:

It says the Facebook app for Android accessed photos, videos and their metadata on Italian users’ phones without specific consent or proper notice. items.title: Jensen Huang Is Out. Everything in AI Is Now Up for Grabs.
items.summary: After a week of escalating revelations — a second affair, a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, and Nvidia's intervention in a Commerce probe — Jensen Huang is out as Nvidia's CEO. Forget the who-did-it speculation for a moment: the bigger story is what changes when the AI industry's linchpin, China bridge, open-source champion and de facto financial backstop is suddenly gone.
